name: Victorian Landcare Grants (Melbourne Water region)

funder.name: Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action (DEECA), Victorian Government

summary: Annual Victorian Government grants for community-led Landcare, Friends, Coastcare and Aboriginal groups doing on-ground work to protect and restore native vegetation, fauna, waterways, wetlands and soils in the Port Phillip and Westernport region. Project grants reach AUD 20,000.

geography.label: Port Phillip and Westernport region, Victoria

amount.note: Project grants; support grants are up to AUD 500

steps: Discuss the project with the Regional Landcare Coordinator

eligibility.rule: Be a community-led Victorian environmental volunteer group/network focused on on-ground environmental improvement
Incorporated, affiliated with Landcare Victoria, or applying through an eligible auspice
Hold at least $20 million in public liability and volunteer personal accident insurance
Have no outstanding reporting from previous Victorian Government funding
Do not propose amenity and beautification projects

documents: Project location map with site IDs where applicable
Written auspice approval or supporting letter, if an auspice is used
Landowner or land manager support letter or email for public land

status.quote: The 2026 Victorian Government Landcare Grants round is now closed.
The next round is expected to be announced in early 2027.

administered_by.quote: Melbourne Water now administers the program for the Port Phillip and Westernport region, following the integration of the CMA in 2022.

applicant_types.quote: Victorian Landcare or environmental volunteer group/network that is community-led and has a focus on on-ground land and natural environment improvement work. This includes: Landcare groups/networks Friends of groups Conservation Management Networks Coastcare Victoria groups Committees of management Aboriginal groups/organisations working on Country

geography.quote: Melbourne Water now administers the program for the Port Phillip and Westernport region, following the integration of the CMA in 2022.

access.quote: For further details on eligibility and how to apply, download the guidelines on this page.

window.quote: The 2026 Victorian Government Landcare Grants round is now closed. The next round is expected to be announced in early 2027.

amount.quote: Project Grants of up to $20,000 are available for on-ground works, community education and engagement, and group/network development activities that protect or improve natural assets such as native vegetation, native fauna, waterways, wetlands and soils.

effort.quote: Please contact your Regional Landcare Coordinator to discuss your project and how it relates to regional priorities before you apply.

eligibility.quote: are a Victorian Landcare or environmental volunteer group/network that is community-led and has a focus on on-ground land and natural environment improvement work.
All unincorporated organisations that aren’t financial members of Landcare Victoria Inc. will need an auspice to apply for a grant.
hold valid Public Liability Insurance of at least $20 million; AND Volunteer Personal Accident Insurance (Landcare Victoria Inc. members automatically meet these insurance requirements.)
If you previously received Victorian Government funding and have outstanding reporting, you are ineligible until overdue reporting requirements are met.

after_award.quote: Once the project is complete, you'll need to submit a report online using the reporting template provided by Melbourne Water

documents.quote: You must complete the 2026 Group Health Survey as part of your application.
You'll need to map the location(s) of the on-ground component of your project and label project sites with a site ID if working on more than one site.
You will need to supply written approval (such as supporting letter) from your sponsor (auspice) as part of your application.
A letter or email demonstrating in-principle support is sufficient for your grant application.
